meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 装上后,服务会用你的个人微信扫码登录,收到发到该微信的消息就转给智能体回复;不需要配置 API 密钥,也不用公网回调地址。
howto.when: 当你明确提出要接入个人微信时,它复制代码、装依赖并引导扫码。之后新联系人发来第一条消息会触发自动建组,便于你接线。

say.text: 帮我把个人微信接入,扫码登录
say.note: 开始安装并提示你扫码

say.text: 给微信渠道接线到默认 agent 组
say.note: 为收到的消息建组并创建 wiring
会话过期时删除凭证并重启

howto.what_en: After install, the service logs into your personal WeChat via QR scan and routes incoming messages to the agent for replies. No API keys or public webhook URL are needed.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask to add personal WeChat. It copies code, installs dependencies, and guides QR login. The first message from a new contact then auto-creates a group for wiring.

say_en.text: Add my personal WeChat and log in via QR
say_en.note: Starts installation and prompts you to scan

say_en.text: Wire the WeChat channel to the default agent group
say_en.note: Creates a group for incoming messages and wires it

say_en.text: Re-scan to log in to WeChat
say_en.note: Clears credentials and restarts after session expiry
